int hype_min_color = 0x6870;
int hype_seconds_color = 0x6870;
const char* hype_time_min_text = "1";
const char* hype_time_sec_text = "30";
const char* playlist_name_hype_text = "Varjish";
const char* playlist_name_rest_text = "Super chill";

int rest_seconds_color = 0x6870;
const char* rest_time_min_text = "2";
const char* rest_time_sec_text = "30";
void drawsettings_hype_rest(void) {
    tft.fillScreen(0x801);
    // hype
    tft.setTextColor(0xFFFF);
    tft.setTextSize(2);
    tft.drawString("Hype:", 20, 33);
    // Layer 11
    tft.setTextSize(1);
    tft.drawString("Time:", 90, 74);
    // Layer 12
    tft.drawString("Playlist:", 90, 110);
    // exercise_based_time_lable
    tft.drawString("Exercise based time", 143, 47);
    // clock_quarters
    tft.drawBitmap(63, 70, image_clock_quarters_bits, 15, 16, 0xFFFF);
    // music
    tft.drawBitmap(63, 105, image_music_bits, 14, 16, 0xFFFF);
    // hype_time_min
    tft.drawString(hype_time_min_text, 135, 74);
    // hype_min
    tft.setTextColor(hype_min_color);
    tft.drawString("Minute(s)", 145, 74);
    // hype_time_sec
    tft.setTextColor(0xFFFF);
